rule: Rule PH(3000): in the seed step, the MC refinement of a candidate (MC then variance stage) has a stall check after 3,000 strict-cost evaluations with no strict gain of its best cost: the hit ratio of the running best (the first lowest-cost orientation) is evaluated once; at 0.95 or more the refinement stops and the check is its final evaluation; else it goes on (the check counted as one evaluation) and checks again 3,000 evaluations after the next gain. CMA fits, the 0.95 stop, the five candidates, the seed test 0.80, rule G1 and the grid search are unchanged. Arm H = arm G (step 9) with PH(3000).
